name: singlet_clustering_model_based_clustering
title: Model-based probabilistic clustering
description: Fits a probabilistic mixture model to raw counts or a latent space and returns per-cell membership probabilities, a hard label and the selected number of components. Use the default zinb_mixture_em when calibrated memberships matter; use a graph-based clustering tool for a plain partition. Requires layers/counts and obs/size_factor. Writes obs/mm_cluster, obs/mm_max_posterior, obsm/mm_posterior, uns/mm_fit and models/mm_model, plus uns/mm_calibration when label_key is set. Long fits may be queued.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Model; zinb_mixture_em is the default. scdeepcluster needs an integer n_components.

n_components.description: Fixed K, or 'auto' to select K in [2, k_max] by BIC or ELBO.

k_max.description: Upper bound for automatic K selection.

batch_key.description: obs column of batch labels, used as a log offset or a decoder covariate.

label_key.description: obs column of reference labels, used for evaluation only.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation and minibatches.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

n_init.description: Random k-means starts on PCs for EM initialisation.

max_iter.description: Maximum EM iterations for each K.

n_latent.description: Latent dimension of the variational autoencoder.

n_hidden.description: Hidden width of encoder and decoder.

n_layers.description: Hidden layers in encoder and decoder.

dropout_rate.description: Dropout rate in encoder and decoder.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed fits: K_selected, criterion (BIC or ELBO), membership_type, converged; calibration (ECE, Brier) when label_key is set.
